## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle commentary on the *[Wú liàng shòu jīng T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060)* is by [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng (the Sānlùn-school master, 549–623). The work presents the Sānlùn-school *Madhyamaka* reading of the Pure Land sūtra, distinct from the *Dìlùn*-Yogācāra reading of [the parallel Huìyuǎn commentary](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0065).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (595 – 623) reflects [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng's mature scholarly period.

The Taishō text (T1746) is established on the standard apparatus.
